info.cls_ename: Professional Master's Program of Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law

description.describe_ch: 以英語授課，開設對象為在職法律相關工作者。學生必須學習使用外文資料庫，以查詢英美法規、判決及文獻。並藉由多樣實務相關教材之使用，以補足學生在法律實務工作上所需之英文能力。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed for legal professionals working in the industry and public sector. This course will lectured in English. Students will be required to learn to use on-line computer research databases for legislations, case laws, various categories of legal documents and academic papers. By providing various practical materials, this course aimed to improve practical English ability for legal professionals.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生熟悉國外司法實務之運作方式。
targets.describe_en: Understand the operation and practical aspects of different legal systems.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生在法律、政治、經濟、金融等領域之涵養。
targets.describe_en: To foster, cultivate students in law, politics, economics, business and finance.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生實務工作上所需之法律英文能力。
targets.describe_en: To develop essential English ability for daily legal practice.

targets.describe_ch: 學習外文資料庫(Lexis和Westlaw)之使用以利學生論文撰寫與實務工作。
targets.describe_en: To strengthen students' thesis writing and   practical ability by perfecting the research skills in legal database such as Lexis and Westlaw.
